$schema_note: Provenance for the verified Replicant Space 3.0.0 OpenAPI and rendered-document corpus.
deprecation_authority_rule: The corrected OpenAPI schema does not set `deprecated: true` on any operation. Deprecation status is established solely by rendered documentation asides (e.g. api/accounts/webhook/index.md, api/replicants/events/index.md, api/locations/inventory/index.md). Rendered deprecation asides override missing OpenAPI deprecation flags and are authoritative for this client.

openapi_documentation_mismatches.difference: OpenAPI declares the cursor query parameter and a 422 response, but still has no 2xx response or text/event-stream framing.
openapi_documentation_mismatches.raw_policy: Implement the documented cursor and standard SSE framing while preserving event names and JSON payloads as open values.

openapi_documentation_mismatches.difference: OpenAPI declares no success-body schemas, and permission mutations declare no request-body schemas.
openapi_documentation_mismatches.raw_policy: Expose these current operations with opaque JSON request/response values; do not invent fields.

openapi_documentation_mismatches.difference: OpenAPI declares no request or success-response schemas for device trades or replicant-visible traders.
openapi_documentation_mismatches.raw_policy: Expose opaque JSON request/response values; do not invent fields from prose examples.

openapi_documentation_mismatches.difference: OpenAPI declares the tutorial routes but no successful response schema; rendered 2.5.1 documentation supplies the only response examples.
openapi_documentation_mismatches.raw_policy: Model the rendered tutorial response fields conservatively with optional fields and flattened unknown-field maps; keep tutorial state server-authoritative rather than inventing persistence semantics.

openapi_documentation_mismatches.difference: OpenAPI continues to describe target as a destination empty_replicant_matrix, while the 2.5.1 FTL Slingshot documentation allows an ftl_slingshot device code whose linked matrix is resolved server-side.
openapi_documentation_mismatches.raw_policy: Keep the existing string target wire shape and document both matrix and slingshot device codes; do not add a duplicate slingshot transport endpoint.

openapi_documentation_mismatches.difference: Rendered System Wards documentation adds warding, activated/deactivated, and evicted_miners response fields that are absent from DeviceCommandResponseSchema.
openapi_documentation_mismatches.raw_policy: Promote the documented ward response fields while retaining the existing flattened extra object for forward compatibility.

openapi_documentation_mismatches.difference: OpenAPI declares the one-time equipment-locker mutation and its DeviceCommandResponse schema, but the rendered api/devices/retrieve page remains the ordinary device-details GET page and does not document this POST.
openapi_documentation_mismatches.raw_policy: Treat OpenAPI as authoritative for the route, no-body mutation shape, response type, and non-retryable mutation safety; use the changelog and FTL Slingshots/System Wards pages only for equipment-locker gameplay semantics.

openapi_documentation_mismatches.difference: The 3.0.0 changelog says species responses include environmental preferences, but SpeciesSchema in OpenAPI still exposes only the pre-3.0 fields and the rendered corpus does not document the preference object shape.
openapi_documentation_mismatches.raw_policy: Preserve the additional response data through Species.extra rather than inventing field names or value shapes until an authoritative schema or endpoint example is available.

openapi_documentation_mismatches.difference: The rendered 3.0.0 location documentation replaces the prior planet/moon examples with a new environmental/physical field set, while OpenAPI does not provide a corresponding detailed body schema.
openapi_documentation_mismatches.raw_policy: Model the documented Season Three environmental fields as optional and retain all additional body fields through the open body map.

openapi_documentation_mismatches.difference: Terraforming documentation states that active terraform monitors emit terraforming.status, but the event is absent from the rendered Event Catalogue and OpenAPI has no event payload schema.
openapi_documentation_mismatches.raw_policy: Preserve unknown event names and payloads through the existing open event envelope; do not invent a typed terraforming.status payload until its wire shape is documented.

openapi_documentation_mismatches.difference: The updated Quickstart renders inventory items as an object map while the unchanged OpenAPI schema still declares the established array shape.
openapi_documentation_mismatches.raw_policy: Retain the OpenAPI-backed inventory model until authoritative endpoint output confirms a contract change; record the rendered example as a documentation discrepancy rather than guessing a new wire shape.

notes: Versioned reference snapshots live under reference/replicant-space-X-Y-Z; scripts/reference_snapshot.py selects the highest semantic version as the current contract.

Replicant Space 3.0.0 keeps 75 paths and 89 operations, adds one OpenAPI command schema (DetonateSchema), device configuration settings, detect_object command discrimination, and parameterized detonate.

Rendered 3.0.0 docs add the Season Three planetary/environment model, terraforming mechanics, intentional Kuiper-object impacts, and mining.relocated. Planet/moon observations from before the season reset are not authoritative and are invalidated by managed-store schema migration 9.
